title: feat!: rewrite in Python, replacing Go binary entirely
description:
## Summary

- Rewrite the entire tool from Go to Python — 12 modules, 43 tests, full feature parity
- Replace the Go binary + Python subprocess shim with a native Python FastMCP MCP server
- Per-user OAuth token support: Bearer header (standalone), Connect credential exchange via posit-sdk, env var fallback (stdio)
- Same 5 MCP tools, same CLI subcommands (scan, inspect, compact, init-config, serve)
- httpx-based GitHub client with per-user/per-resource rate limiting
- pyarrow Parquet caching with Hive partitioning, boto3 S3 storage
- Connect deployment installs directly from GitHub repo via git+https

## Breaking changes

- Go binary no longer distributed. Install via `pip install agentic-adoption-scan`
- `github_token` tool parameter removed — tokens extracted transparently from HTTP headers

## Test plan

- [x] `pytest tests/ -v` — 43 tests pass
- [x] CLI: `agentic-adoption-scan scan --org posit-dev --days 7 --verbose` — scanned 75 repos, found 122 indicators across 49 repos
- [x] MCP stdio: connected in Claude Code via `.mcp.json`, all 5 tools visible and functional
- [x] Connect deployment (connect.posit.it, v2026.03.0): deployed via rsconnect, ASGI app starts correctly
- [x] Connect MCP OAuth: Claude Code authenticated via Connect's OAuth 2.1 flow (DCR + PKCE + RFC 9728), server connected with 5 tools
- [x] Stateless HTTP mode: verified with Connect's multi-pod load balancing (two processes on separate pods)
- [x] DNS rebinding protection disabled for Connect reverse proxy
- [ ] MCP HTTP standalone: `serve --transport http` with Bearer token (not tested end-to-end)
- [ ] Connect OAuth credential exchange for per-user GitHub tokens (requires GitHub viewer OAuth integration configured by Connect admin)
- [ ] S3 cache: `--cache-dir s3://bucket/path`

## Issues discovered and fixed during testing

- Rate limit buckets: GitHub's `code_search` (10/min) and `core` (5000/hr) use separate budgets via `X-RateLimit-Resource` header — mixing them caused spurious 60s waits
- DNS rebinding: MCP SDK's default transport security rejects non-localhost Host headers; disabled for Connect deployments
- Stateless mode: required for Connect's multi-pod load balancing (sessions can't be pinned to a process)
- ASGI entrypoint: `FastMCP` object is not directly ASGI-callable; must use `mcp.streamable_http_app()`

title: Address Copilot review comments; add native uv build backend
description:
Nine Copilot review comments on the three-layer eval framework (PR #17) — covering missing build backends, incorrect CI conditions, connection leaks, and missing graceful-skip logic.

## Build system
Both `evals/inspect/pyproject.toml` and `evals/connect/pyproject.toml` lacked a `[build-system]` table, causing `pip install -e .` to fail in CI. Added uv's native build backend:

```toml
[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.6.0,<0.11.0"]
build-backend = "uv_build"
```

`uv_build` uses a src layout and requires a Python package module, so minimal `src/mcp_evals/__init__.py` and `src/connect_deploy_tests/__init__.py` stubs were added to satisfy that requirement.

## `mcp_eval_tasks.py`
- **`list_indicators_quality`** and **`adoption_agent_eval`**: both now return a trivial no-op/skip `Task` when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is absent, matching the stated "skip gracefully" design.
- **`--cache-dir`**: subprocess now passes `--cache-dir <tmpdir>` on the CLI rather than `MCP_CACHE_DIR` (which the Go binary does not read), isolating cache state per eval run.

## `conftest.py`
`http_client` fixture changed from `return` to `yield` with `try/finally → client.close()` to avoid leaking connections across the test session.

## Workflow conditions
- **`pr-connect-deploy.yml`**: job `if:` now also checks `secrets.CONNECT_LICENSE != ''` so the job actually skips when the secret is absent.
- **`pr-evals.yml`**: both LLM step conditions changed from `env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY != ''` (always false — env vars aren't set at evaluation time) to `secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY != ''`.

title: feat(evals): add three-layer eval framework for MCP server
description:
Adds a comprehensive eval and test framework across three layers, all running on every pull request:

**Layer 1 — Go unit tests (pr-checks.yml)**
- `agentic-adoption-scan/mcpserver_test.go`: 13 new handler-level tests covering list_indicators structure/schema/content, required-param validation for all five tools, cache-miss behaviour, and marshalToolResult.
- Updated `pr-checks.yml` to run `go vet` + `go test -race` before the GoReleaser dry-run.

**Layer 2 — Inspect AI evals (pr-evals.yml)**
- `evals/inspect/mcp_eval_tasks.py`: three eval tiers:
  - Deterministic (no LLM): list_indicators_structure, list_indicators_schema
  - Semantic/LLM-as-judge (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY): list_indicators_quality
  - Agent integration (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + GITHUB_TOKEN): adoption_agent_eval
- Deterministic tasks always run; LLM tasks skip gracefully when secrets absent.
- Eval logs uploaded as workflow artifacts.

**Layer 3 — Connect deployment test (pr-connect-deploy.yml)**
- `evals/connect/test_connect_deploy.py`: four pytest classes proving the Python MCP wrapper deploys to Posit Connect and every tool is reachable via the Streamable HTTP MCP transport.
- Follows the posit-dev/with-connect pattern: ephemeral Connect container (Docker), rsconnect deploy, pytest smoke tests, teardown.
- Skips gracefully for forks/PRs without CONNECT_LICENSE secret.

Design doc in evals/README.md.

title: Add Streamable HTTP transport with stateless mode for Posit Connect
description:
The MCP server previously only supported stdio transport. Posit Connect
requires Streamable HTTP with stateless mode per the deployment guidance
at https://docs.posit.co/connect/user/mcp-servers/.

Changes:
- mcpserver.go: Extract newMCPServer() helper to avoid tool registration
  duplication, add StartMCPHTTPServer() using NewStreamableHTTPServer with
  WithStateLess(true) and the conventional /mcp endpoint path
- main.go: Add --transport flag (stdio|http), --host, and --port flags to
  the serve command; respect PORT env var (injected by Posit Connect)
- go.mod: Promote mcp-go to a direct dependency after go mod tidy

Usage for Posit Connect deployment:
  agentic-adoption-scan serve --transport http
